text.fuckinguselessmod.config.title: Fucking Useless Mod Configuration
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.descriptio: Enable or disable the mod's chat transformations.
Choose how transformed text is applied to chat messages.
Choose how block characters are selected when block effects are enabled.
Choose the encoding steps used in Encode mode. The order of the steps matters.
Number of bit positions to rotate during the bit rotation step. Range: 0-7.
Byte value used by the bitwise XOR encoding step. Range: 0-255.
Apply Zalgo corruption to transformed text.
Chance for Zalgo corruption to be applied to a transformed message. Range: 0.0-1.0.
Allow block-character effects to appear in transformed text.
Chance for a block-character effect to be applied to a transformed message. Range: 0.0-1.0.
Maximum length of the transformed message. Range: 1-256.
Presets to apply to transformed text. Entries must match available preset names.
Apply the dedicated Uwuifier transformation to chat messages.
